parser_quality_control.old_artifact_issue_repaired: Previous artifact misread fold-change/FICI columns as assay values and used table headers as target species. This rebuild keeps target species as Candida albicans SC5314 or named mammalian/fungal cells and stores fold-change/FICI only in assay_conditions.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact numeric tables from S1/S2 supplementary PDFs and figure-level values from S1/S2 TIFFs cannot be source-reviewed locally. Main-text XML/PDF values and supplement captions were preserved, but the missing media blocks publication-grade acceptance under obtainable-only mode.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The XML declares supplementary media pone.0132701.s001.pdf, s002.pdf, s003.tif, and s004.tif, but those media files are not present in the local landed/packet supplementary directory. The local supplementary assets are HTML/landing/license pages, not the referenced PDF/TIFF payloads; no local archive or OA package member contains them.
